verses.translation: A Psalm of instruction for Asaph. Give heed, O my people, to my law: incline your ear to the words of my mouth.

translations.ron: Luaţi aminte, poporul meu, la legea mea, plecaţi urechile voastre spre graiurile gurii mele.
translations.grk: Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ. Προσέχετε λαός μου τὸν νόμον μου, κλίνατε τὸ οὖς ὑμῶν εἰς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.

verses.translation: I will open my mouth in parables: I will utter dark sayings which have been from the beginning.

translations.ron: Deschide-voi în pilde gura mea, spune-voi cele ce au fost dintru început,
translations.grk: Ἀνοίξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου, φθέγξομαι προβλήματα ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς.

verses.translation: All which we have heard and known, and our fathers have declared to us.

translations.ron: Câte am auzit şi am cunoscut şi câte părinţii noştri ne-au învăţat.
translations.grk: Ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν καὶ ἔγνωμεν αὐτὰ, καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν διηγήσαντο ἡμῖν.

verses.translation: They were not hid from their children to a second generation; the fathers declaring the praises of the Lord, and his mighty acts, and his wonders which he wrought.

translations.ron: Nu s-au ascuns de la fiii lor, din neam în neam,
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν, ἀπαγγέλλοντες τὰς αἰνέσεις Κυρίου καὶ τὰς δυναστείας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησε.

verses.translation: And he raised up a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, to make it known to their children:

translations.ron: Vestind laudele Domnului şi puterile Lui şi minunile pe care le-a făcut.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστησε μαρτύριον ἐν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ νόμον ἔθετο ἐν Ἰσραήλ· ὃν ἐνετείλατο τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν, γνωρίσαι αὐτὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν,

verses.translation: that another generation might know, even the sons which should be born; and they should arise and declare them to their children.

translations.ron: Şi a ridicat mărturie în Iacob şi lege a pus în Israel.
translations.grk: ὅπως ἂν γνῷ γενεὰ ἑτέρα, υἱοὶ οἱ τεχθησόμενοι, καὶ ἀναστήσονται καὶ ἀπαγγελοῦσιν αὐτὰ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν·

verses.translation: That they might set their hope on God, and not forget the works of God, but diligently seek his commandments.

translations.ron: Câte a poruncit părinţilor noştri ca să le arate pe ele fiilor lor, ca să le cunoască neamul ce va să vină,
translations.grk: ἵνα θῶνται ἐπὶ τὸν Θεὸν τὴν ἐλπίδα αὐτῶν, καὶ μὴ ἐπιλάθωνται τῶν ἔργων τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσωσιν.

verses.translation: That they should not be as their fathers, a perverse and provoking generation; a generation which set not its heart aright, and its spirit was not steadfast with God.

translations.ron: Fiii ce se vor naşte şi se vor ridica, şi le vor vesti fiilor lor,
translations.grk: Ἵνα μὴ γένωνται ὡς οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν, γενεὰ σκολιὰ καὶ παραπικραίνουσα, γενεὰ ἥτις οὐ κατεύθυνεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστώθη μετὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: The children of Ephraim, bending and shooting with the bow, turned back in the day of battle.

translations.ron: Ca să-şi pună în Dumnezeu nădejdea lor şi să nu uite binefacerile lui Dumnezeu şi poruncile Lui să le ţină,
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἐφραὶμ ἐντεινοντες καὶ βάλλοντες τόξον, ἐστράφησαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου.

verses.translation: They kept not the covenant of God, and would not walk in his law.

translations.ron: Ca să nu fie ca părinţii lor neam îndărătnic şi răzvrătit,
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐφύλαξαν τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἤθελον πορεύεσθαι.

verses.translation: And they forgot his benefits, and his miracles which he had shewed them;

translations.ron: Neam care nu şi-a îndreptat inima sa şi nu şi-a încredinţat lui Dumnezeu duhul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπελάθοντο τῶν εὐεργεσιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ, ὧν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς·

verses.translation: the miracles which he wrought before their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Tanes.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Efraim, arcaşi înarmaţi, întors-au spatele, în zi de război.
translations.grk: ἐναντίον τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἃ ἐποίησε θαυμάσια, ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ, ἐν πεδίῳ Τάνεως.

verses.translation: He clave the sea, and led them through: he made the waters to stand as in a bottle.

translations.ron: N-au păzit legământul lui Dumnezeu şi în legea Lui n-au v rut să umble.
translations.grk: Διέῤῥηξε θάλασσαν, καὶ διήγαγεν αὐτοὺς· ἔστησεν ὕδατα ὡσεὶ ἀσκόν.

verses.translation: And he guided them with a cloud by day, and all the night with a light of fire.

translations.ron: Şi au uitat facerile Lui de bine şi minunile Lui, pe care le-a arătat lor,
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν νεφέλῃ ἡμέρας, καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐν φωτισμῷ πυρός.

verses.translation: He clave a rock in the wilderness, and made them drink as in a great deep.

translations.ron: Minunile pe care le-a făcut înaintea părinţilor lor, în pământul Egiptului, în câmpia Taneos.
translations.grk: Διέῤῥηξε πέτραν ἐν ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ πολλῇ.

verses.translation: And he brought water out of the rock, and caused waters to flow down as rivers.

translations.ron: Despicat-a marea şi i-a trecut pe ei; stătut-au apele ca un zid;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ὕδωρ ἐκ πέτρας, καὶ κατήγαγεν ὡς ποταμοὺς ὕδατα.

verses.translation: And they sinned yet more against him; they provoked the Most High in the wilderness.

translations.ron: Povăţuitu-i-a pe ei cu nor ziua şi toată noaptea cu lumină de foc;
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν αὐτῷ· παρεπικραναν τὸν ὕψιστον ἐν ἀνύδρῳ,

verses.translation: And they tempted God in their hearts, in asking meat for the desire of their souls.

translations.ron: Despicat-a piatră în pustie şi i-a adăpat pe ei cu bogăţie de apă.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξεπείρασαν τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν, τοῦ αἰτῆσαι βρώματα ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: They spoke also against God, and said, Will God be able to prepare a table in the wilderness?

translations.ron: Scos-a apă din piatră şi au curs apele ca nişte râuri.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατελάλησαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ εἶπαν, μὴ δυνήσεται ὁ Θεὸς ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν ἐν ἐρήμῳ;

verses.translation: Forasmuch as he smote the rock, and the waters flowed, and the torrents ran abundantly; will he be able also to give bread, or prepare a table for his people?

translations.ron: Dar ei încă au greşit înaintea Lui, amărât-au pe Cel Preaînalt, în loc fără de apă.
translations.grk: Ἐπεὶ ἐπάταξε πέτραν, καὶ ἐῤῥύησαν ὕδατα, καὶ χείμαῤῥοι κατεκλύσθησαν· μὴ καὶ ἄρτον δυνήσεται δοῦναι; ἢ ἑτοιμάσαι τράπεζαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ;

verses.translation: Therefore the Lord heard, and was provoked: and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath went up against Israel.

translations.ron: Şi au ispitit pe Dumnezeu în inimile lor, cerând mâncare sufletelor lor.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ἤκουσε Κύριος καὶ ἀνεβάλετο, καὶ πῦρ ἀνήφθη ἐν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ ὀργὴ ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation.

translations.ron: Şi au grăit împotriva lui Dumnezeu şi au zis: "Va putea, oare, Dumnezeu să gătească masă în pustiu?"

verses.translation: Yet he commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

translations.ron: - Pentru că a lovit piatra şi au curs ape şi pâraiele s-au umplut de apă.

verses.translation: and rained upon them manna to eat, and gave them the bread of heaven.

translations.ron: Oare, va putea da şi pâine, sau va putea întinde masă poporului Său?

verses.translation: Man ate angels' bread; he sent them provision to the full.

translations.ron: Pentru aceasta a auzit Domnul şi S-a mâniat şi foc s-a aprins peste Iacob şi mânie s-a suit peste Israel.

verses.translation: He removed the south wind from heaven; and by his might he brought in the south-west wind.

translations.ron: Căci n-au crezut în Dumnezeu, nici n-au nădăjduit în izbăvirea Lui.

verses.translation: And he rained upon them flesh like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the seas.

translations.ron: Şi a poruncit norilor de deasupra şi uşile cerului le-a deschis

verses.translation: And they fell into the midst of their camp, round about their tents.

translations.ron: Şi a plouat peste ei mană de mâncare şi pâine cerească le-a dat lor.

verses.translation: So they ate, and were completely filled; and he gave them their desire.

translations.ron: Pâine îngerească a mâncat omul; bucate le-a trimis lor din destul.

verses.translation: They were not disappointed of their desire: but when their food was yet in their mouth,

translations.ron: Poruncit-a El, din cer, vânt dinspre răsărit şi a adus cu puterea Lui vânt dinspre miazăzi.

verses.translation: then the indignation of God rose up against them, and slew the fattest of them, and overthrew the choice men of Israel.

translations.ron: Şi a plouat peste ei ca pulberea cărnuri şi ca nisipul mării păsări zburătoare.

verses.translation: In the midst of all this they sinned yet more, and believed not his miracles.

translations.ron: Şi au căzut în mijlocul taberei lor, împrejurul corturilor lor.

verses.translation: And their days were consumed in vanity, and their years with anxiety.

translations.ron: Şi au mâncat şi s-au săturat foarte şi pofta lor şi-au împlinit-o.

verses.translation: When he slew them, they sought him: and they returned and called betimes upon God.

translations.ron: Nimic nu le lipsea din cele ce pofteau şi mâncarea le era încă în gura lor,

verses.translation: And they remembered that God was their helper, and the most high God was their redeemer.

translations.ron: Când mânia lui Dumnezeu s-a ridicat peste ei şi a ucis pe cei sătui ai lor şi pe cei aleşi ai lui Israel i-a doborât.

verses.translation: Yet they loved him only with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

translations.ron: Cu toate acestea încă au mai păcătuit şi n-au crezut în minunile Lui.

verses.translation: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they steadfast in his covenant.

translations.ron: Şi s-au stins în deşertăciune zilele lor şi anii lor degrabă.

verses.translation: But he is compassionate, and will forgive their sins, and will not destroy them: yea, he will frequently turn away his wrath, and will not kindle all his anger.

translations.ron: Când îi ucidea pe ei, Îl căutau şi se întorceau şi reveneau la Dumnezeu.

verses.translation: And he remembered that they are flesh; a wind that passes away, and returns not.

translations.ron: Şi şi-au adus aminte că Dumnezeu este ajutorul lor şi Dumnezeul Cel Preaînalt este izbăvitorul lor.

verses.translation: How often did they provoke him in the wilderness, and anger him in a dry land!

translations.ron: Dar L-au înşelat pe El, cu gura lor şi cu limba lor L-au minţit.

verses.translation: Yea, they turned back, and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

translations.ron: În inima lor n-au fost drepţi cu El, nici n-au crezut în legământul Lui.

verses.translation: They remembered not his hand, the day in which he delivered them from the hand of the oppressor.

translations.ron: Iar El este îndurător, va curăţi păcatele şi nu-i va nimici.

verses.translation: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Tanes:

translations.ron: Îşi va întoarce de multe ori mânia Lui şi nu va aprinde toată urgia Lui.

verses.translation: and had changed their rivers into blood; and their streams, that they should not drink.

translations.ron: Şi-a adus aminte că trup sunt ei, suflare ce trece şi nu se mai întoarce.

verses.translation: He sent against them the dog-fly, and it devoured them; and the frog, and it spoiled them.

translations.ron: De câte ori L-au amărât în pustiu, L-au mâniat în pământ fără de apă?

verses.translation: And he gave their fruit to the canker worm, and their labours to the locust.

translations.ron: Şi s-au întors şi au ispitit pe Dumnezeu şi pe Sfântul lui Israel L-au întărâtat.

verses.translation: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamores with frost.

translations.ron: Nu şi-au adus aminte de braţul Lui, de ziua în care i-a izbăvit pe ei din mâna asupritorului.

verses.translation: And he gave up their cattle to hail, and their substance to the fire.

translations.ron: Că a făcut în Egipt semnele Lui şi minunile Lui în câmpia Taneos:

verses.translation: He sent out against them the fury of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and affliction, a message by evil angels.

translations.ron: El a prefăcut în sânge râurile lor şi apele lor, ca să nu bea.

verses.translation: He made a way for his wrath; he spared not their souls from death, but consigned their cattle to death;

translations.ron: El a trimis asupra lor tăuni şi i-a mâncat pe ei; şi broaşte şi i-a prăpădit pe ei.

verses.translation: and smote every first-born in the land of Egypt; the first-fruits of their labours in the tents of Cham.

translations.ron: Dat-a stricăciunii rodul lor şi ostenelile lor, lăcustelor.

verses.translation: And he removed his people like sheep; he led them as a flock in the wilderness.

translations.ron: Bătut-a cu grindină via lor şi duzii lor cu piatră.

verses.translation: And he guided them with hope, and they feared not: but the sea covered their enemies.

translations.ron: Dat-a grindinii dobitoacele lor şi averea lor focului.

verses.translation: And he brought them in to the mountain of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand had purchased.

translations.ron: Trimis-a asupra lor urgia mâniei Lui; mânie, urgie şi necaz trimis-a prin îngeri nimicitori.

verses.translation: And he cast out the nations from before them, and made them to inherit by a line of inheritance, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

translations.ron: Făcut-a cale mâniei Lui; n-a cruţat de moarte sufletele lor şi dobitoacele lor morţii le-a dat.

verses.translation: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies.

translations.ron: Lovit-a pe toţi cei întâi-născuţi din Egipt, pârga ostenelilor lor, în locaşurile lui Ham.

verses.translation: And they turned back, and broke covenant, even as also their fathers: they became like a crooked bow.

translations.ron: Ridicat-a ca pe nişte oi pe poporul Său şi i-ţa dus pe ei, ca pe o turmă, în pustiu.

verses.translation: And they provoked him with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

translations.ron: Povăţuitu-i-a pe ei cu nădejde şi nu s-au înfricoşat şi pe vrăjmaşii lor i-a acoperit marea.

verses.translation: God heard and lightly regarded them, and greatly despised Israel.

translations.ron: Dusu-i-a pe ei la hotarul sfinţeniei Lui, muntele pe care l-a dobândit dreapta Lui.

verses.translation: And he rejected the tabernacle of Selom, his tent where he dwelt among men.

translations.ron: Izgonit-a dinaintea lor neamuri şi le-a dat lor prin sorţi pământul de moştenire;

verses.translation: And he gave their strength into captivity, and their beauty into the enemy's hand.

translations.ron: Şi a aşezat în corturile lor seminţiile lui Israel.

verses.translation: And he gave his people to the sword; and disdained his inheritance.

translations.ron: Dar ei au ispitit şi au amărât pe Dumnezeul Cel Preaînalt şi poruncile Lui nu le-au păzit.

verses.translation: Fire devoured their young men; and their virgins mourned not.

translations.ron: Şi s-au întors şi au călcat legământul ca şi părinţii lor, întorsu-s-au ca un arc strâmb.

verses.translation: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows shall not be wept for.

translations.ron: Şi L-au mâniat pe El cu înălţimile lor şi cu idolii lor L-au întărâtat pe El.

verses.translation: So the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and as a mighty man who has been heated with wine.

translations.ron: Auzit-a Dumnezeu şi S-a mâniat şi a urgisit foarte pe Israel.

verses.translation: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he brought on them a perpetual reproach.

translations.ron: A lepădat cortul Său din Şilo, locaşul Lui, în care a locuit printre oameni.

verses.translation: And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

translations.ron: Şi a robit tăria lor şi frumuseţea lor a dat-o în mâinile vrăjmaşului.

verses.translation: but chose the tribe of Juda, the mount Sion which he loved.

translations.ron: Şi a dat sabiei pe poporul Său şi de moştenirea Lui n-a ţinut seama.

verses.translation: And he built his sanctuary as the place of unicorns; he founded it for ever on the earth.

translations.ron: Pe tinerii lor i-a mistuit focul şi fecioarele lor n-au fost înconjurate cu cinste.

verses.translation: He chose David also his servant, and took him up from the flocks of sheep.

translations.ron: Preoţii lor de sabie au căzut şi văduvele lor nu vor plânge.

verses.translation: He took him from following the ewes great with young, to be the shepherd of Jacob his servant, and Israel his inheritance.

translations.ron: Şi S-a deşteptat Domnul ca cel ce doarme, ca un viteaz ameţit de vin,

verses.translation: So he tended them in the innocency of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

translations.ron: Şi a lovit din spate pe vrăjmaşii Săi; ocară veşnică le-a dat lor.
